automation_policy.QUALIFIES: issue proof when all other protocol checks pass
automation_policy.REVIEW_REQUIRED: continue service normally; do not issue automatic proof

mixed_language: qualify strong contextual Welsh; mark ambiguous evidence for review
learner_language: supported; errors and code-switching do not alone disqualify
evidence_rule: Combine phrase, distinctive lexical, ratio and context evidence; ambiguous Welsh-like tokens alone are insufficient.
